title: Pocketwire Rewards Tier Comparison: Purchase Minimums, Earning Caps and Pending Period
content:
The table sets, for each Pocketwire Rewards tier, the smallest purchase that earns, whether recurring charges earn, the per-purchase and monthly caps on base plus category points, and the pending period before earned points can be redeemed.

| Tier | Recurring card charges earn | Smallest settled purchase that earns (USD) | Most base plus category points on one purchase | Most base plus category points per calendar month | Pending period (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pocketwire Rewards Member | No | 5.00 | 5000 | 10000 | 30 |
| Pocketwire Rewards Silver | Yes | 1.00 | 7500 | 20000 | 30 |
| Pocketwire Rewards Gold | Yes | 1.00 | 10000 | 40000 | 14 |
| Pocketwire Rewards Platinum | Yes | 1.00 | 15000 | 60000 | 14 |
| Pocketwire Rewards Diamond | Yes | 1.00 | 25000 | 100000 | 7 |
| Pocketwire Rewards Obsidian | Yes | 1.00 | 50000 | 250000 | 0 |

## What each column means

- Recurring card charges earn: whether recurring card charges earn points on that tier.
- Smallest settled purchase that earns: the smallest settled purchase amount, in USD, that earns points.
- Most base plus category points on one purchase: the maximum base plus category points earned on one purchase.
- Most base plus category points per calendar month: the maximum base plus category points earned per calendar month; purchases beyond it earn nothing that month.
- Pending period: the calendar days after the earning date before earned points become redeemable. A pending period of 0 days means earned points are redeemable from the earning date.

## Points of comparison

- A recurring charge on a Pocketwire Rewards Member membership earns no points, because the Member row shows No; on every other tier it earns.
- A settled purchase of exactly 5.00 USD reaches the Member minimum; a purchase of 4.99 USD does not. On the other tiers the minimum is 1.00 USD.
- Points earned on a Diamond membership stay pending for 7 calendar days; on Silver for 30.
